An interacting four-site exact example f(r)=1/[4(r+1)]+(r+1)/[4((r+1)^2+16)] has nonreal poles, rejecting a positive Stieltjes representation in r, not complete monotonicity. Standard positive-real/Herglotz machinery instead yields F(w)=integral w/(w^2+x)mu(dx), w=d+r, mu>=0,totalmass<=a. Thus f(r)/(d+r) is Stieltjes in (d+r)^2; no measure-acquisition oracle is assumed.

For c=1+r/d,0<=c f(r)-f(0)<=(a/d)(c-1)/(c+1). A legitimately acquired node estimate fhat with error<=delta gives interval[c(fhat-delta)-(a/d)(c-1)/(c+1),c(fhat+delta)], intersect[0,a/d]. At a/d=1/4,r=d/8, midpoint=(9/8)fhat-1/136 and delta=1/425 gives error exactly.01, versus prior ten-node~1.49e-10. A sharper data-dependent moment interval is also provided; it is sharp for the positive-measure information class, not every spin model. Separate exact three-node resolvent weights6,-8,3 have total17 and bias<=1/1140.

The inherited estimator still implies~1.57e45 sufficient samples at the one node. A proved hypocoercive Lyapunov estimate ||exp(-B_rt)||<=sqrt3 exp(-beta t) enables deterministic cutoff Tcut=beta^-1 log[4a sqrt3/(beta delta)] and uniform-time bounded readout. Hoeffding requires N>=32(nt^2 Tcut)^2 delta^-2 log(2/failure); numerical law errors remain charged. At n8,t1,d2,h_sum18,sigma1/128, beta~8.62764e-9,Tcut~2.99767e9 and99% confidence, N~1.76e28. These are conservative sufficient UPPER prescriptions, not timings, lower bounds or practical performance. Artificial full monitoring is deliberately added and removed; failure to extract resets from physical onsite noise does not refute this distinct method. Thermodynamic transfer remains separate.

Projection locality: for degree-three translation-covariance one-hop fluxes in dephased XXZ, pressure is an exclusion gap-graph Laplacian L on(a,b)>=1 and Pi_K=I-C*(CC*)dagger C, independent of positive dephasing strength. The harmonic polynomial h=(a-b)(2a+b-2)(a+2b-2) has nonzero moment6 against local source delta_(2,1)-delta_(1,1). Exponential decay of the pressure gradient would permit summation by parts giving6=0. The actual uniform-current first effective action has source proportional to delta_(1,2)-delta_(2,1), harmonic moment-12. Thus this balance projection cannot inherit ordinary exponential physical-support locality. No sharp algebraic exponent, resolvent-tail identity or universal solver lower bound follows. Compact v,w with D*w=b still give finite certificates2<b,v>-||Dv||^2<=||DLdagger b||^2<=||w||^2 and gap||w-Dv||^2; economical convergence remains open.

Nonlocal compression: one-hop spectator-toggle R satisfies -A_diag^2 E=8U^2(E-R E); T2=8Pi(I-R)Pi. Compact four-edge balanced cycles show ||Pi_(k+2)R_+Pi_k||>=1/4 for every odd k>=3. Exact finite n7,n11 calculations from actual current retain nonzero degrees3,5,7 and reject fixed degree3/5 exact closures only. Fixed-k exclusion Green functions do not evaluate cross-degree contractions after each insertion. The tested k! q^k quadrature count is an implementation cost, not a general lower bound; a simple scattering gauge factorization fails without excluding every determinant method. Infinite-volume finite heat cutoffs have full operator error1; finite-ring cutoff O(n^2 log(1/eta)) and telescoping iteration errors do not provide source-specific infinite-volume accuracy. A supplied positive T approximation needs eta_T<=epsilon d^3/a under the stated resolvent bound. No economical closure is acquired.

Full four-site two-particle t=U=d=1 has -1.112<K_(1001,1010)(1/2)<-1.111, with rational50th-series remainder certification reported. This is not merely a truncated two-hop cosine or a waiting-time density. On four same-charge configurations, q/d=[[0,1,1,2],[1,0,2,1],[1,2,0,1],[2,1,1,0]], vector(1,-1,-1,1) has zero sum and c^Tqc=0. These obstructions reject the tested positive-renewal/reset shortcut, not every quantum renewal/resummation or transport algorithm.
